title: Te Kuiti Land Development Office, 1974–1984
credit: Archives New Zealand; photograph by an unidentified photographer; via Wikimedia Commons.
altText: The Te Kuiti Land Development Office building used by the Lands and Survey Department during 1974–1984.
caption: The Te Kuiti Land Development Office building, used by the Lands and Survey Department during 1974–1984. Photograph date not recorded.
context: The Archives New Zealand description identifies this as the building occupied by the Te Kuiti Land Development Office during 1974–1984; the photograph date is not specified. It shows a provincial land-administration office, not the national cadastral database team or a GIS workplace.
